item.title: Tesla Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
item.description: AUSTIN, Texas, July 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Tesla, Inc. (NASDAQ: TSLA) today announced financial results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026. Revenue was $27.9 billion, up 4% year over year, and GAAP net income was $2.1 billion. Automotive gross margin improved to 19.4% on higher deliveries and continued cost reduction. The company reaffirmed full-year guidance for vehicle deliveries and said its next-generation platform remains on track for initial production in the first half of 2027. Free cash flow for the quarter was $1.3 billion and cash and investments ended the quarter at $32.4 billion.

item.title: Global Widget Market to Reach $18 Billion by 2031, Says NewResearch Partners
item.description: DUBLIN, July 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- NewResearch Partners has published a comprehensive report on the global widget market, projecting growth to $18 billion by 2031.
